_source: Item ID->name maps derived from mozartdiniz/ds3-advisor data files. The upstream project declares no licence; what is reproduced here is factual game data (numeric item IDs and their in-game display names), not source code. 2026-10-29: corrected three truncated ring names that the upstream table carries (Havel +3 DLC -> Havel's Ring +3 DLC, Steel and Protection +3 DLC -> Ring of Steel Protection +3 DLC, Ring of Evil Eye +3 -> Ring of the Evil Eye +3). Left uncorrected they create ring 'families' with no base variant, i.e. collectibles that can never be completed.
